liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Shakedown Street into C.C. Rider opening signals a show that hits hard; Shakedown Street was explosive, with the band smoking from the start [15][16]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Reviewer lists Let It Grow among the respectable first-set highlights, alongside Shakedown, Jack-a-Roe and Brown Eyed Women; Let It Grow is described as off the charts [12][15]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the second-set Morning Dew as especially good; Morning Dew came as a closing sermon delivered by Jerry [11][16]
- **C.C. Rider** (1 review): Jerry's playing on C.C. Rider is singled out [18]
- **On The Road Again** (1 review): On The Road Again sounds wonderful to the reviewer [20]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Second set opened quickly with Playin' going into deep psychedelia, with Bobby playing wildly [12]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha is called especially strong on this night [18]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the second-set Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad as especially good [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-09-26.mtx.chappel.sb10.30117.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 153 min; rated 4.92/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: A small part of second-set Drums is missing [1]
- **gd81-09-26.sbd.miller.18110.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 154 min; rated 4.38/5 by 37 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes each set fits on one 80-minute disc; Reviewer says the sound quality is not the best [11][19]
- **gd1981-09-26.aud.unknown.willy.9418.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1981-09-26.152508.beyer201prescott-holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 21 songs; 138 min [5]

## Around the show

- Band took the stage an hour or more late, reportedly because they were attending a Rolling Stones concert [12]
- Fans' day in Buffalo included Anchor Bar roast beef sandwiches and Deadheads gathering on the USS The Sullivans [14]
- The Johnny B. Goode encore honored Chuck Berry's birthday [18]
- The first set hooked the reviewer, whose first Dead tape in 1982 was this show [19]
- The show was part of a short East Coast run before the band went to Europe [20]
- An MC flip occurred at 8:06 of Drums and was used as the track break [3]
- Security confiscated several tape decks from the area in front of the soundboard, reportedly six to seven [5]
- Reviewer ranks the show among the best from 1977 to 1982 [13]
- Reviewer found the Salt Palace 1981 show lacking the extra something this show has [15]
- Reviewer calls this one of a strange, hot three-show mini-tour and rates the May–September 1981 tours among the best [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-09-26.mtx.chappel.sb10.30117.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: SBD (18110) + AUD (12554) [1]. Also: Matrix mix; Shakedown, C.C. Rider and about eight minutes of Drums come from audience source only [1]
- **gd81-09-26.sbd.miller.18110.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard to cassette to DAT to CD, with audience patches, via Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1981-09-26.aud.unknown.willy.9418.shnf**: transferred by Willy Munder; source: AUD>MC>?>CD [3]. Also: Audience tape retracked and verified with CD Wave and Shntool, edited in CE2K; discs supplied by Scott Shindell [3]
- **gd1981-09-26.152508.beyer201prescott-holbrook.flac2448**: taped by David Prescott; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Microphones: Beyer M201c (worn in hat??) Recorder: Sony TC-D5 Maxell UDXLII no nr Location: Balcony behind and above drums [5]. Also: As of 2021, only four unique audience sources of this show exist on LMA [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1981-09-26 Community War Memorial Auditorium, Buffalo, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1981-09-26-community-war-memorial-auditorium-buffalo-ny-usa/) [26]
- Photo by Jurassic Blueberries (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead 9-26-1981 Buffalo Community War Memorial Auditorium - Original Cassette Tape Case Set List Artwork](https://www.flickr.com/photos/59863270@N07/21074081175/) [27]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/59863270@N07/21074081175/) [28]
